buyers.whyTitle: Six reasons that matter in calculation.

No rust, no encrustation, no pitting risks like with metallic pipes.

rfq.privacy: By submitting, you open a pre-filled email to info@k-aqua.de. No data is stored on this site.
rfq.doneText: Your email programme has opened with the pre-filled request. Send it off, we'll get back to you within a working day. Prefer to speak directly?
rfq.infoText1: Use our request tool to coordinate your construction or industrial project with our experts at an early stage. Whether you are in the planning phase or already have concrete material lists, we will support you with dimensioning and material selection.
rfq.infoText2: Through close cooperation with K Aqua Sales, you'll not only receive precise offers but also valuable technical advice regarding pressure ratings (SDR classes), laying methods, and system-compliant accessories. Send us your parameters, and we'll get back to you within one working day.

faqs.q: Is the project request subject to a fee?
faqs.a: No, the use of this tool and the subsequent preparation of an offer by our sales team are completely free of charge and non-binding for you.

faqs.q: What happens after the request is sent?
faqs.a: Your request is sent directly to our internal sales team. A personal contact person will get in touch with you within 24 hours to clarify any open questions or present a tailored offer.

faqs.q: Can I also make a request as a private individual?
faqs.a: K Aqua is primarily aimed at wholesalers, planners, and professional installers in the B2B sector. We are happy to refer private customers to our regional specialist partners.

Your inputs are not stored on the server but transferred directly to your email programme, from where you can securely send the request to us. We treat your data strictly confidential according to current GDPR guidelines.
